assertions.title: Default view graceful without Factory accounts

steps.action: Run `node shuvquota.js` with no Factory accounts configured
steps.expected: Codex/Claude displayed normally, exit code 0, no Factory errors in stderr
steps.observed: Codex and Claude quota boxes displayed normally, exit code 0, stderr empty

steps.action: Run `node shuvquota.js --json` with no Factory accounts
steps.expected: JSON output includes factory key with no error, exit code 0
steps.observed: JSON output has "factory": [] (empty array, no error object), exit code 0, stderr empty

steps.expected: All pre-existing tests pass (5 port 1455 failures are pre-existing)
steps.observed: 417 pass, 5 fail (pre-existing startCallbackServer port 1455), 969 expect() calls

steps.action: Review Factory module imports for codex/claude-specific dependencies
steps.expected: Factory modules only import from shared/generic modules
steps.observed: factory-accounts.js imports: jwt.js, container.js, factory-crypto.js. factory-usage.js imports: constants.js. factory-crypto.js imports: node:path, fs.js. No imports from codex-*.js or claude-*.js

MULTI_ACCOUNT_PATHS (line 49): codex-accounts.json + opencode path. CLAUDE_MULTI_ACCOUNT_PATHS (line 22): claude-accounts.json. Both unchanged. Factory uses separate FACTORY_MULTI_ACCOUNT_PATH constant.

steps.action: Run `node shuvquota.js codex quota` and `node shuvquota.js claude quota`
steps.observed: Both commands display their respective quota boxes normally with exit code 0
Routes to Factory handler, shows 'No Factory accounts found' with guidance (expected, no accounts configured)
Displays Codex quota boxes normally, exit code 0
Displays Claude quota boxes normally, exit code 0

steps.expected: Error message does not reference Factory
steps.observed: Error: 'add' now requires a namespace. Use 'shuvquota codex add' or 'shuvquota claude add'. No mention of factory.

steps.action: Run unit tests for Factory routing: `bun test --grep 'handleFactory'`
steps.observed: 12 pass, 0 fail — covers no subcommand, help, unknown subcommand, quota routing

steps.action: Run unit tests for handleQuota scope: `bun test --grep 'handleQuota with factory'`
steps.observed: 3 pass, 0 fail — covers scope='factory', scope='all', JSON with factory key

steps.expected: All tests pass (5 pre-existing port failures acceptable)
steps.observed: 417 pass, 5 fail (pre-existing startCallbackServer port 1455), 969 expect() calls across 422 tests

steps.action: Verify barrel re-exports for all new Factory functions
steps.expected: Every new exported function has a barrel re-export in shuvquota.js
steps.observed: factory-accounts.js: 9/9 re-exported. factory-usage.js: 4/4 re-exported. factory-crypto.js: 5/5 re-exported. display.js factory exports: 4/4. handlers.js factory exports: 2/2. All accounted for.

steps.action: Verify test conventions: describe/test/expect, env cleanup, temp file isolation
steps.observed: Tests use bun:test imports (describe, test, expect, beforeEach, afterEach). Tests import from ./shuvquota.js barrel. env cleanup in afterEach. Temp files use os.tmpdir(). 114 Factory-specific tests all pass.

summary: Tested 4 assertions: 4 passed, 0 failed. All cross-area validations confirmed: default view gracefully handles missing Factory accounts (VAL-CROSS-003), backward compatibility maintained with unchanged Codex/Claude functionality and clean module boundaries (VAL-CROSS-006), CLI namespace isolation verified with correct routing and no Factory leakage into legacy commands (VAL-CROSS-007), test suite integrity confirmed with 417 passing tests, complete barrel re-exports, and convention-compliant test code (VAL-CROSS-008). The 5 pre-existing startCallbackServer failures on port 1455 are environment-specific and unrelated to Factory features.
